xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5587: Antigravity harness: run Gemini models through agy acp (API key and Agent Platform auth only)

plan.title: Antigravity harness: run Gemini models through agy acp (API key and Agent Platform auth only)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Adding a literal to the Harness union forces coordinated edits across contracts, src/lib, CLI, dashboard server and frontend (type-forced Records plus hand-copied harness lists), and a harness that is selectable but not launchable delivers zero value. PAN-5078 (Grok Build) and PAN-3668 (Prime Agent) kept the same full scope for the same reason. The work is decomposed into 23 small items with explicit dependency edges so leaves run in parallel.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck runs Gemini models only through pi or other API-key harnesses; it cannot run them inside Google's own agent CLI, Antigravity (agy), which replaced Gemini CLI for consumer users. Antigravity's terms (clause 6) forbid third-party software from using Antigravity OAuth, so any integration must use only a Gemini API key or Agent Platform credentials.
narratives.Proposal: Add an `antigravity` harness on the existing ACP host that launches `agy acp --gemini-dir <OVERDECK_HOME>/antigravity` for existing Google model ids (no new provider). The host resolves the credential itself (Gemini API key from env or Overdeck settings, else Agent Platform project+location+ADC), authenticates only with gemini-api-key or agent-platform, sets model and the clamped thought_level on every start including resume, records ACP-standard turn usage for an antigravity cost source priced from the google rows, and surfaces credential failures through acp-launch-error. Pickers, doctor, CLI, config, conversations, docs and a no-loss audit cover the new literal; replay fixtures and a live run verify it. Facts come from live probes of agy 1.5.14 recorded in the PRD.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Any OAuth path: oauth-personal, oauth-business, terminal-login, `agy acp --login`, or reading ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json.
- Gemini CLI as a harness.
- A native terminal-UI agy harness or a companion terminal attaching the agy TUI.
- Running Antigravity agents on Fly machines.
- A new model provider or new model ids; changing Google provider defaults or tier models (PAN-5586 owns new Gemini ids).
- Choosing Agent Platform per agent while an API key is configured.
- Delivering context through agy's _meta.antigravity.systemPrompt.append instead of the ACP initial-context channel.
- Distributing Overdeck skills or plugins into the Antigravity gemini dir.
- Reading agy's private conversation databases or logs, or cleaning up its log directory.
- Passing --dangerously-skip-permissions, --sandbox, --disable-telemetry or --process-per-session.
- Modeling Gemini free-tier or Agent Platform contract pricing.
- Adding antigravity to scripts/lint-harness-branches.sh pattern N, or raising any ratchet baseline or file-size allowlist row.
- Changing #752.

autoDecisions.summary: New harness literal `antigravity` on the ACP host, ACP provider key `antigravity`, executable `agy`.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the Grok Build precedent the issue names; per-harness binary, capabilities, policy and picker entries need their own literal.

autoDecisions.summary: No new model provider: the harness runs existing bare Google ids (gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.1-pro-preview as agy gemini-3.1-pro; Gemini 4 Neon/Carbon/Hydrogen once PAN-5586 registers them).
autoDecisions.rationale: With gemini-api-key auth agy bills the same Gemini API key the google provider uses, and the issue acceptance names bare ids and asks for Antigravity "as a harness for Google models".

autoDecisions.summary: The ACP host main() resolves the credential (literal key from the enabled Google provider, else Agent Platform project+location+ADC) instead of the launcher passing pane env; no env GEMINI_API_KEY source.
autoDecisions.rationale: The host is Overdeck code and can read config; the key never enters a pane env or launcher script; avoids five launch-site edits, two over the size ceiling; dropping the env source keeps the picker/doctor status and the pane-side launch in agreement, since panes blank GEMINI_API_KEY.

autoDecisions.summary: Always launch agy with an isolated --gemini-dir <OVERDECK_HOME>/antigravity.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps agy away from ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json and the oauth-personal selectedType on this host; a structural guard for the no-OAuth decision; verified live that isolated mode works with an API key.
Probed: agy sends session/request_permission with allow_once/reject_once options that the host already auto-answers.

autoDecisions.summary: Effort maps to agy thought_level, clamped to the levels the selected model offers; harness levels low..xhigh, default high.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed: thought levels vary per model and none offers max; effort-high-default rule.

autoDecisions.summary: Cost is estimated from ACP turn usage at Gemini API list prices via a new antigravity reconcile source.
autoDecisions.rationale: Probed: agy reports per-turn usage but no cost; the issue allows estimates if the PR says so.

autoDecisions.summary: Agent Platform is implemented and unit-tested but not live-verified.
autoDecisions.rationale: The reference host has no gcloud or ADC; recorded as an implementation checkpoint.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the work as one issue with sizeJustification.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same reasoning as PAN-5078: a harness literal forces coordinated edits and a partial harness delivers zero value.
